summary: Master pension fund liquidity management. Learn ALM, LDI, and cash flow matching to ensure solvency and optimize benefit payments. Enroll today.
lede: Pension fund liquidity management methods help analysts, treasury managers, risk officers, actuaries and trustees match available assets to benefit payments. The course covers forecasting contributions and benefit outflows, stress-testing liquidity under market shocks, and designing liability-driven hedges and cash-flow plans, including for alternative assets.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the financial health and regulatory compliance of defined benefit and defined contribution schemes.
audience: Financial Controller for large-scale corporate retirement schemes
Asset Liability Management (ALM) Specialist in pension
modules: Foundations of Pension Fund Liquidity and ALM
Cash Flow Forecasting and Liability Modeling
Liquidity Risk Measurement and Stress Testing
Managing Liquidity in Alternative Asset Portfolios
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of financial markets and basic fixed income mathematics. Experience with Microsoft Excel for financial modeling is required. No prior programming or coding experience is necessary, as all modeling will be conducted using standard spreadsheet tools and provided templates.
